observations: Front wheel has a red fork blade.
Rear wheel has a black fork blade.
The bike is leaning against a blue plastic barrel.
The frame has a 'T' logo on the down tube, but the full brand name is not legible.
The bike is in an outdoor, possibly damp or dusty environment.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The carbon fiber frame may have cracks or delamination not visible in a single photo.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the frame tubes under bright light.

risks.risk: The drivetrain (gears and chain) may be seized or heavily worn.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being pedaled through all gear ranges.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a full drivetrain rebuild

risks.risk: The brakes may be worn or the pads may be contaminated.
risks.proof: A photo of the brake pads and a video of the brakes being applied.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the bike being pedaled through all gears to check the drivetrain.
Photo of the brake pads and a video of the brakes being squeezed.
Close-up photo of the frame to check for cracks or carbon fiber damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
